topic.name: 向心力实验
topic.title: 是什么力让物体不断转弯？
topic.question: 是什么力让物体不断转弯？
topic.description: 剪绳、旋转沙袋、双球向心力演示器与玻璃漏斗，从不同装置辨认向心合力并控制变量。
topic.tag: 向心合力 · 控制变量 · 测力

sources.title: OpenStax — Uniform and Nonuniform Circular Motion
OpenStax — Solving Problems with Newton’s Laws

translations.是什么力让物体不断转弯？: Which force keeps an object turning?
translations.剪绳、旋转沙袋、双球向心力演示器与玻璃漏斗，从不同装置辨认向心合力并控制变量。: Use string release, a rotating bag, a two-ball demonstrator and a glass funnel to identify radial resultants and isolate variables.
translations.向心合力 · 控制变量 · 测力: Radial resultant · Controlled variables · Force measurement
translations.变速塔轮带动两个旋转槽，球压挡板，经杠杆拉动弹簧测力套筒: Stepped pulleys drive two rotating channels; ball pressure acts through levers on spring sleeves
translations.剪断绳子，球沿切线离开: Cut the string and the ball departs tangentially
translations.手感受到的是绳张力，它还要托住重力: The hand feels tension, which must also support weight
translations.漏斗壁的支持力与重力合成向心力: Funnel support and gravity combine into the radial resultant
translations.只改变质量，比较两球向心力: Change only mass and compare radial forces
translations.角速度相同，改变轨道半径: Keep angular speed fixed and change orbital radius
translations.角速度加倍，向心力怎样变化？: What happens to force when angular speed doubles?
translations.先看清挡板、杠杆与测力套筒的传力路径: First follow force through the stop, lever and spring sleeve
translations.水平圆周 · 绳子实际倾斜: Horizontal circle · The string is inclined
translations.光滑桌面圆周运动的小球在剪断绳后沿切线运动: A ball on a smooth table follows its tangent after string release
translations.倾斜绳悬挂的沙袋沿水平圆周转动，张力有向上与向心分量: A bag on an inclined string circles horizontally; tension has vertical and inward components
translations.小球在透明漏斗内作水平圆周运动，斜向支持力与重力的合力水平向内: A ball orbits inside a transparent funnel; oblique support plus gravity gives a horizontal inward resultant
translations.拉力消失后保留瞬时速度；向心力不是把球向外甩的力。: After tension disappears, instantaneous velocity remains; centripetal force does not throw the ball outward.
translations.张力的竖直分量平衡重力，水平分量才提供向心力。: Vertical tension balances gravity; only its horizontal component supplies centripetal force.
translations.向心力是合力的作用效果，不是在重力和支持力之外再增加一个力。: Centripetal force names the resultant’s effect, not an extra force added to gravity and support.
translations.一次只改变一个量，标尺经杠杆与弹簧校准后比较作用力。: Change one variable at a time and compare forces after lever–spring calibration.
translations.仪器按传力路径重建，刚性杠杆与滑动接头保持连接；套筒按弹簧与力矩平衡校准，不冒充: The apparatus reconstructs the force path with rigid levers and sliding clevises; sleeves are calibrated by spring and torque balance, not presented as dimensions of a specific commercial model.
translations.水平圆周为理想稳态，忽略空气阻力和摩擦；沙袋绳倾角与漏斗角速度由受力条件求得。: Horizontal orbits are ideal steady states without air drag or friction; bag inclination and funnel angular speed follow force balance.

cues.title: 剪绳看离开方向
cues.titleEn: Cut the string and observe departure
cues.caption: 拉力消失，瞬时速度沿切线保留下来。
cues.captionEn: Tension vanishes while tangent velocity remains.
cues.zh: 细线牵引小球在光滑水平桌面上转动，拉力一直指向中心。把细线剪断以后，小球不再沿圆周走，也不是沿半径向外飞出，而是保持剪断瞬间的速度，沿切线前进。这个观察说明，维持圆周运动需要不断改变速度方向的力；一旦这项约束消失，就不再发生同样的转弯。
cues.en: A string pulls a ball around a smooth horizontal table, with tension directed inward. Cutting it ends the circle. The ball neither continues curving nor departs radially: it retains its instantaneous tangent velocity. Circular motion requires a continuing force to change direction; removing that constraint removes the turn.

cues.title: 辨认手感中的张力
cues.titleEn: Identify the tension felt by the hand
cues.caption: 张力还有竖直分量，不能完全当成向心力。
cues.captionEn: Tension also has a vertical component and is not entirely centripetal.
cues.zh: 在绳的一端悬挂小沙袋，让它在水平面内转动。教材提醒我们，手感受到的张力并不完全等于向心力，因为沙袋还受到重力。实际绳子略向下倾斜，张力的竖直分量托住沙袋，水平分量才使它转弯。改变绳长和转速时，本片同时计算倾角和圆周半径，不把任意水平半径强加给受力不平衡的沙袋。
cues.en: Swing a small bag on a string in a horizontal circle. The textbook notes that hand tension is not entirely centripetal because gravity also acts. The inclined string has an upward component supporting the bag and a horizontal component turning it. Changing string length or angular speed recomputes inclination and orbit radius rather than imposing an arbitrary unbalanced circle.

cues.title: 看清演示器如何测力
cues.caption: 球压挡板，经杠杆改变测力套筒位置。
cues.captionEn: Ball pressure moves a spring sleeve through a lever.
cues.zh: 向心力演示器用塔轮带动两个旋转槽。小球随槽转动，挡板向内推小球；球对挡板的反作用通过推杆和杠杆传到弹簧测力套筒。套筒位置经校准后显示力的大小。先让两边质量、半径和角速度都相同，检查两边读数一致，再开始控制变量比较。不能只看到套筒运动，就跳过球受到哪个力的问题。
cues.en: Stepped pulleys drive two rotating channels. A stop pushes each ball inward; the ball’s reaction passes through a pushrod and lever to a spring sleeve. Calibrated sleeve position indicates force. Begin with identical masses, radii and angular speeds and check equal readings. Follow which force acts on the ball rather than treating sleeve movement as an unexplained measurement.

cues.title: 只改变质量
cues.caption: 同半径、同角速度，质量加倍使力加倍。
cues.captionEn: At fixed radius and angular speed, doubling mass doubles force.
cues.zh: 保持两边转动半径和角速度相同，换上一颗质量为原来两倍的球。它的转弯方式没有改变，但维持同样加速度需要的合力加倍。仪器右侧的读数因此变为左侧的两倍。这个比较隔离了质量的影响，不能同时换更大的半径或改变塔轮档位，否则就不再是单一变量实验。
cues.en: Keep radii and angular speeds equal and double one ball’s mass. Its acceleration pattern is unchanged, but twice the mass requires twice the net force. The right reading doubles. This isolates mass: changing radius or pulley ratio at the same time would destroy the single-variable comparison.

cues.title: 只改变半径
cues.caption: 同质量、同角速度，半径加倍使力加倍。
cues.captionEn: At fixed mass and angular speed, doubling radius doubles force.
cues.zh: 把两球质量调回相同，保持角速度相同，只把右侧轨道半径加倍。右侧向心力也加倍。这里保持的是角速度，不是线速度；较大半径的球每秒走过更长的弧，线速度也变大。讨论半径增大时力如何改变，必须明确还保持了哪个速度量，不能脱离控制条件单独判断。
cues.en: Restore equal masses and angular speeds, then double the right orbit radius. Its force doubles. Angular speed is held fixed, not linear speed; the larger circle carries the ball farther each second. Any statement about increasing radius must specify which speed quantity remains controlled.

cues.title: 只改变角速度
cues.caption: 塔轮使角速度加倍，向心力变为四倍。
cues.captionEn: A pulley change doubles angular speed and quadruples force.
cues.zh: 保持质量和半径相同，把传动带移到另一档塔轮，使右侧角速度变成左侧两倍。测力结果变成四倍，说明这里的角速度关系是平方关系。结合前面的质量和半径比较，可以用质量乘角速度的平方再乘半径表达向心力。三次比较分别改变一个量，才构成相互支持的证据。
cues.en: Keep mass and radius fixed and change the stepped-pulley ratio so the right angular speed doubles. Its force becomes four times larger, revealing a square dependence on angular speed. Together with the mass and radius comparisons, this gives force equal to mass times angular speed squared times radius. Each controlled comparison supplies a distinct part of the evidence.

cues.title: 漏斗里是谁推球转弯
cues.titleEn: What turns the ball inside a funnel?
cues.caption: 斜向支持力与竖直重力同时存在。
cues.captionEn: Oblique support and vertical gravity act together.
cues.zh: 在光滑玻璃漏斗内，小球可以短时间沿某一水平圆周运动。它没有连着绳子，却仍然需要向心合力。漏斗壁对球的支持力斜向上、斜向内，重力竖直向下。观察球与漏斗面的接触位置：支持力沿表面法线，并不是沿轨迹的切线。这个装置帮助我们识别不同场景里由谁提供转弯的作用。
cues.en: A ball can briefly orbit horizontally inside a smooth glass funnel. No string is attached, but a radial resultant is still needed. Surface support points upward and inward while gravity points down. Support is normal to the funnel surface, not tangent to the path. This apparatus identifies a different interaction providing the turn.

cues.title: 向心力是合力的名称
cues.caption: 竖直分量抵消，水平向内分量留下。
cues.captionEn: Vertical components cancel, leaving the inward horizontal part.
cues.zh: 把两种力一起看，支持力的竖直分量与重力抵消，剩下的水平向内分量使小球转弯。因此不能在重力和支持力之外再画一个独立的向心力；向心力只是这些真实相互作用合成后的作用效果。本片选择满足水平匀速圆周条件的角速度，改变圆周半径时也同步更新它，使轨迹与受力保持一致。
cues.en: Combine the forces. The vertical part of support cancels gravity, leaving an inward horizontal resultant that turns the ball. Do not add another independent centripetal force to support and gravity; the term describes their combined effect. The model chooses an angular speed satisfying horizontal circular balance and updates it when radius changes, keeping force and motion consistent.
